messages:
Priya Rao: Quick heads-up 9CedarTech customer story9D aiming to go live Tue 10am PT. We still need the final quote consent + a confirmed one-line quote (or a 30s audio) from CedarTech by EOD tomorrow. Also finalize webinar speakers and the benchmark slide (include method note).

Mira Chen: I can ping J. Patel at CedarTech now. Do we prefer a verbatim quote or something we lightly edit?

Priya Rao: Prefer verbatim if possible. If they want edits, Legal needs to approve the final wording.

Tony Alvarez: I'll take the webinar logistics. Suggested lineup: product walkthrough (Mira), CedarTech PM, and a short customer Q&A. Plan: 20m demo, 15m live questions. Need benchmark slide: 95th pct latency, throughput (tokens/sec), and an estimated $/1M tokens number. Add a short method blurb.

Azra Khan: Routing: registrants who select 'Pilot interest' -> SDR-A queue; others -> nurture. I'll add a hidden form field for 'current inference provider' so SDRs can triage.

Sam Li: LegalBot ran the template and flagged language: remove any absolute claims like "no tail latency" and add explicit publish consent. Suggested consent snippet below.

Sam Li: ```By submitting this statement, CedarTech grants Redwood Inference permission to publish the quote and company name in marketing materials.```

LegalBot: AUTO-CHECK: Replace absolute performance claims with qualifiers (e.g., "subject to workload profile"). Ensure logo use and audio release boxes are checked. Policy: https://redwood.internal/legal/marketing-permissions

Mira Chen: Heard back: CedarTech okay with text quote only. Draft from J: "Redwood reduced our inference costs and improved tail latency for customer-facing agents." They didn't include numbers.

Tony Alvarez: Can we nudge them to add a percent? If not, publish text and add "anonymized metric available on request". Also I'll mock the benchmark slide with provisional numbers for the dry run.

Priya Rao: OK. Mira, ask if they can share either (a) percent cost reduction or (b) avg cost per 1k tokens. If no, publish as-is and mark metrics as on-request. LegalBot: when Mira uploads quote, run consent check and ping me.

Azra Khan: I'll create HubSpot tag `webinar-cedartech-2026` and automation: on publish tag attendees, and send registrants who chose "Pilot interest" to SDR-A immediately.

Sam Li: Owners and deadlines: Quote text (Mira) 5:00 today; Legal approval (Sam/LegalBot) 6pm tomorrow; Slides + method note (Tony) 9am Mon; Dry run (Tony + panel) Mon 4pm. Please ack.

Mira Chen: Ack 5:00 quote. I'll ask for specific numbers but will accept text if they decline.

Tony Alvarez: Ack slides + dry run. I'll include 95th pct numbers and a compact method note: "Benchmarks run on a 4k context, MLP model variant v2, synthetic load matching customer traffic patterns."

Azra Khan: Ack routing + form field. Will add a hidden "current_provider" field and HubSpot mapping.

LegalBot: Reminder: collect logo use permission and audio-release checkbox. Run consent scan after upload.

Priya Rao: Great work team. Once the quote lands, Mira upload to /marketing/case-quotes and @LegalBot run the quick check. We'll finalize by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
